payload.description: A small compact low heap of tiny DRY BROKEN BONE FRAGMENTS, a battle-remains ground prop for a muted dark fantasy pixel art game. Draw 12 to 16 small unequal bone fragments packed close together in two flat overlapping layers: short snapped tubular bits with chipped hollow ends, tiny irregular knuckly joint chips, thin gently bent segments and small flat flakes. Each fragment only 3 to 7 pixels long and at most one fifth of the heap width. Flat broad uneven oval footprint occupying 36x18 pixels centered inside a 64x64 transparent canvas, generous empty transparent space on all sides. Anonymous small bony fragments, different lengths and shapes WITHIN each heap. Crisp simple low-detail pixel clusters; dirty pale ivory, gray-taupe middle tones and purple-gray dark crevices; light from upper left. A connected low pile resting flat, viewed from above at shallow three-quarter angle. ONLY the small loose broken fragments, no skull or face, no intact long bones, no display base, no ground, no other objects. New compact arrangement for each candidate.
